criterion: Provides mainframe modernization services to enterprise customers.
source_body: Example Systems modernizes enterprise customers' legacy mainframe environments. It replaces older mainframe hardware with a current generation, upgrades the system software and migrates existing workloads to that environment. This modernization service does not rewrite the customer's application code.
